llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed deep-research workflow with some broad web-research and packaging-script cautions, but I found no hidden execution, persistence, credential handling, or malicious behavior.

dimensions.detail: High-volume web search and content extraction are proportionate to the stated 100+ source research goal, but users should expect significant network/tool use.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install-time execution was found. The package script is manually invoked and creates a .skill archive, though it does not reject symlinks if a compromised tree is packaged.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger text is broad and the workflow ingests arbitrary web/PDF content without an explicit prompt-injection trust-boundary rule, but these behaviors are expected for a deep-research skill.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: I found no persistence hooks, credential/session/profile use, privilege escalation, background workers, or destructive local actions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The main artifact describes autonomous multi-source research, source verification, and report synthesis; the bundled scripts are ancillary packaging and validation helpers, not a replacement or hidden runtime purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent to perform large, autonomous web/PDF research runs. Keep retrieved web content treated as untrusted evidence, review source quality carefully, and do not run the packaging script from a directory containing untrusted symlinks.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: Downgraded: the packaging and validation scripts are maintenance helpers shipped alongside the research instructions; they are not evidence that the skill misrepresents its runtime purpose.
[LP3] unexpected: Partially supported: the frontmatter lacks a formal allowed-tools field, but the body names the research tools it expects to use.
[SQP-1] expected: Supported as a caution: broad triggers such as research and analysis may invoke the skill often, but the trigger examples still match the disclosed research purpose.
[SQP-3] expected: Low security relevance: the Japanese/English template mix may affect usability, not privilege, hidden behavior, or data safety.
[T09] expected: Supported as a design caution: the skill processes untrusted web and PDF content and should explicitly treat retrieved instructions as data only.
[T09] unexpected: Supported only for the manual packaging helper: package_skill.py can archive symlink targets if a symlink is introduced, but the submitted artifact contains no symlinks and the script is not automatically executed.
